messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the **federal long weekends** in Canada for 2023.  
(These are the holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or are observed on a Monday when the actual date lands on a weekend, giving you a 3‑day break.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|--------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | **Jan 2** (Sunday Jan 1 observed on Monday) | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** |
| Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | **Feb 20** (3rd Monday in February) | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** |
| Good Friday | **Apr 7** | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** |
| Victoria Day | **May 22** (Mon before May 25) | **May 20 – May 22** |
| Canada Day (observed) | **Jul 3** (Sat Jul 1 observed on Mon) | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** |
| Labour Day | **Sep 4** | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** |
| Thanksgiving | **Oct 9** | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** |
| Remembrance Day (observed) | **Nov 13** (Sat Nov 11 observed on Mon) | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** |
| Christmas | **Dec 25** | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** |

> **Note:**  
> • Boxing Day (Dec 26) falls on a Tuesday in 2023, so it does **not** create a long weekend.  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patricks Day in Ontario, Civic Holiday in Quebec, etc.) that may also produce long weekends. The table above lists the federal holidays that apply nationwide.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific long weekends, let me know and I can break those down for you.
